name: nestjs-ecommerce-microservices
description: Full-stack e-commerce microservices architecture with NestJS backend and Next.js frontend

scripts.start:services: concurrently "npm run start:dev --prefix product-service" "npm run start:dev --prefix order-service"
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start:dev --prefix product-service" "npm run start:dev --prefix order-service" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build:services: npm run build --prefix product-service && npm run build --prefix order-service
scripts.test:services: npm run test --prefix product-service && npm run test --prefix order-service
